question: What was total revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.line_total_inr) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.order_date) = 2025

question: How much revenue did we make in October 2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.line_total_inr) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND i.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31'

question: How many orders were placed in 2025, including cancelled ones?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025

question: How many delivered orders did we have in the first quarter of 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.orders` WHERE status = 'delivered' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question: Which category brought in the most revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT i.category AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.line_total_inr) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is our overall return rate, as a share of order lines in delivered orders?
sql: SELECT COUNTIF(i.returned) / COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: What was the return rate for rugs from June to October 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNTIF(i.returned) / COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND i.category = 'rug' AND i.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-10-31'

question: Rug returns went up after May 2026. Which brand is driving it?
sql: SELECT i.brand AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND i.category = 'rug' AND i.order_date >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY COUNTIF(i.returned) / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most common reason customers give for returning rugs since June 2026?
sql: SELECT return_reason AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` WHERE category = 'rug' AND returned AND order_date >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which city has placed the most orders?
sql: SELECT city AS v FROM `{t}.orders` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of 2026 orders came through the app?
sql: SELECT COUNTIF(channel = 'app') / COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026

question: Which month had the most orders?
sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS v FROM `{t}.orders` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many desks did we sell in 2025 (units, including returned ones)?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` WHERE category = 'desk' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025

question: How did desk revenue in January to October 2026 compare with January to October 2025? Give both numbers.
sql: SELECT SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.order_date) = 2025, i.line_total_inr, 0)) AS v2025, SUM(IF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.order_date) = 2026, i.line_total_inr, 0)) AS v2026 FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND i.category = 'desk' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.order_date) <= 10

question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `{t}.orders` GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: What percentage of orders get cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNTIF(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS v FROM `{t}.orders`

question: What share of 2025 revenue came from tier 1 (metro) cities?
sql: SELECT SUM(IF(o.city_tier = 1, i.line_total_inr, 0)) / SUM(i.line_total_inr) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.order_date) = 2025

question: Which cushion product sold the most units overall? Give its product id.
sql: SELECT product_id AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` WHERE category = 'cushions' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many days does delivery take to tier 3 cities?
sql: SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF(delivered_date, order_date, DAY)) AS v FROM `{t}.orders` WHERE city_tier = 3 AND status = 'delivered'

question: What was revenue during the 2025 festive season, 1 October to 10 November?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.line_total_inr) AS v FROM `{t}.order_items` i JOIN `{t}.orders` o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT i.returned AND i.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-11-10'
